consequence.statement: Promtail instances deployed from rpm/deb packages without a custom configuration will use an improved default configuration that reduces CPU consumption when /var/log contains many files.

assertion.statement: Promtail's default configuration in rpm/deb packages was improved to reduce CPU utilization when many files exist in /var/log.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence identifies the component (Promtail) and scope (rpm/deb default config) but does not specify which configuration key or file was changed; change: the evidence describes the purpose (avoid high CPU) and affected scope (rpm/deb packages, /var/log) but does not state what specific configuration value or behavior changed
